status: provisional: every figure below is replaced by the printer's own before the plates are made; the artwork follows them without being redrawn

endpapers.spec: sapphire endpapers: the page's rulings and the series' words pressed into the colour in its own tone (Bible, ch. 25 §13)

case.covering: litho-printed cover sheet (150 g/m² coated), soft-touch matte laminate

paperback.note: the study edition (Bible, ch. 25 §5); set "binding": "paperback" to write its wraps

finishes.print: CMYK + PANTONE 2728 C (spot sapphire); the substrate a 240 dpi raster, everything else vector
finishes.cold_foil: gold cold foil laid inline on the press, before the inks: the glosses' rulings, the device's rulings, the satin rules of the frames; no line under 0.10 mm; knocked out of every ink
finishes.laminate: soft-touch matte, after print and cold foil

hot_foil.gold: bright gold: the lit dots of the glosses, the seams and their jewels, the gold rules of the frame and the matn, the paragraph marks, the reference's numerals, the seal
hot_foil.pearl: pearl: the title, the volume's numeral, the names, the pearl rules
hot_foil.ruby: ruby metallic: the vowels (harakat) of the lit glosses and the nūn's dot of «صناعة»; nothing else (the ruby is meaning, not ornament)

finishes.emboss: sculpted, depth as grey (EMBOSS plate): the matn raised, the title registered under its pearl foil, the seams, the jewels, the lit dots
finishes.deboss: blind: the matn's own rulings under its lines (DEBOSS plate)
finishes.spot_uv: the glosses' letters (the latent rasm) and their unlit dots: a whisper seen only when the book is tilted; never over foil (SPOT-UV plate)
finishes.order: cold foil and inks on the press → soft-touch laminate → hot foils and emboss/deboss (combination dies) → spot UV

extras.top_edge: gilt (gold): the head of the page block (flagship edition)

editions.note: Three official cover editions of the same book (Bible ch. 25 §14); same trim, boards, spine widths, plates and spot colour; the art differs. Plates in covers/<folder>/.

heritage.name: Heritage: the illuminated binding (shamsa)
heritage.cold_foil: the rays of the medallion, the frame's roundels, the engraving of the back's row
heritage.hot_foil_gold: the tooled frame and its chain, the cornerpieces (quarter rosettes), the medallion's rim, chain and strapwork rosette, the heading panel's rules, the seal
heritage.hot_foil_pearl: the title, the numerals, the plaque's name, fine rules
heritage.hot_foil_ruby: the nun's dot of the title; the nib's dot over each medallion's number; on the spines, the band's jewel of the first and the tenth, and the great stroke's first touch on the first
heritage.spot_uv: the medallion, the heading panel, the plaque, the great stroke (on the board only)
heritage.emboss: the medallion, the title, the numerals

contemporary.name: Contemporary: the architecture of the line
contemporary.cold_foil: the flutes of the uprights, the construction (plumb lines, compass, module scale), the echoes and pulses of the line
contemporary.hot_foil_gold: the line, the lit edges of the uprights, the floating dots (jewels), the frame's rule, the seal
contemporary.hot_foil_pearl: the title, the knots, the spine's numeral and name, the thesis engraved along the beam
contemporary.hot_foil_ruby: one dot on each front where the nib first touches, and the nun's dot of the title
contemporary.spot_uv: none by default: the field stays open
contemporary.emboss: the uprights and the title; no deboss
